text: Megan Drupals, Toronto Urban Fellow; and Michael Hain, Program Manager, Policy and Analysis Unit, Transportation Planning will give a presentation on Accessible Parking Review. Transportation Planning is undertaking Phase 2 of their review of the Zoning By-Law for New Developments, which includes a review of Accessible Parking Space requirements. We will discuss our current data and data collection strategies, proposed outreach, and initial considerations for by-law updates.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
